messages:
maria: Heads up — saw a support ticket where a customer's dashboard preview during a canary rollout showed rows from another org. Not great :grimacing:
alex: oh wow. got the ticket? link?
maria: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/98765 — repro steps: open console -> Dashboards -> choose canary rollout preview -> select filters -> see other org rows
sam: I tried repro: can repro with local canary flag. looks like the preview request isn't including org context when we call internal preview API.
maria: logs show requests to /api/preview?canary=true with no X-Org-ID header:
```
GET /api/preview?canary=true
Host: console.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
# no X-Org-ID header
```
jen: @alex @nathan could this be fallout from the rollout routing changes? maybe affinity routing moved preview traffic through a proxy that strips headers?
alex: yeah I made the routing change last week for 'preview affinity' — proxy was intentionally normalizing headers. didn't think about internal-preview calls. investigating.
nathan: I see the proxy config: `strip_sensitive_headers=true` for the affinity route. we added that to avoid leakage of customer tokens, but that also strips the X-Org-ID.
jen: we need a safe whitelist: allow X-Org-ID for internal requests that are authenticated and destined for console-preview. quick patch: proxy whitelist header if `Service-Internal: preview` present.
alex: agree. proposed fix: change ingress rule:
```
if service == 'console-preview' and auth.jwt.client == 'internal':
  preserve_headers += ['X-Org-ID']
```
I'll open PR.
maria: also need to audit everywhere we do preview -> ensure server-side fallback uses token claims instead of header. not all clients will send header.
sam: good call. server should always validate org from bearer token when possible. I'll add a telemetry event for any preview response that includes rows where row.org_id != request.org_id so we can catch regressions :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy started for alex/preview-proxy-fix (sha abc123)
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/456 — adds proxy whitelist + unit tests. requesting review @jen @maria
jen: LGTM. schedule to canary on staging and run the support repro steps.
maria: assigning follow-ups: alex -> proxy patch & rollout; sam -> server fallback + telemetry; jen -> test plan & support reply. I'll draft support response.
nathan: I'll check billing/quotas to ensure no cross-org quota accounting happened.
maria: thanks. we'll keep thread updated. low severity but customer-facing; prioritize.
